label: US-CA-AB1609-2026 SECTION 1. / 22626.

obligations.text: (a)A large private business shall not represent that a customer service chatbot is a human.

(b)A large private business shall provide a clear and conspicuous disclosure that the customer service chatbot is artificially generated and not human if a reasonable person interacting with the customer service chatbot is likely to be misled to believe that the person is interacting with a human.
(c)The disclosure required by subdivision (b) shall be clear and conspicuous, and provided in the medium in which the customer service chatbot interacts with the customer.
